channel.title: Rafal Reed - Latest Guides and Projects
channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure guides and project write-ups from Rafal Reed.

item.title: SharePoint Site Types: Which One Should You Use?
item.description: A quick guide to SharePoint Team, Communication, Hub, Channel and Home sites, including when to use each type, their advantages and disadvantages, and practical examples.

item.title: How to Grant Access to One SharePoint Folder Without Granting Access to the Whole Library
item.description: A practical guide to granting access to a single SharePoint folder without exposing the entire document library, including permission inheritance, security groups and common mistakes.

item.title: When to Use Office Scripts Instead of Power Automate Expressions
item.description: Learn when Power Automate expressions are enough and when Office Scripts are the better choice. This guide explains the difference with simple examples and practical rules for building cleaner, easier-to-maintain Excel automations.

item.title: Understanding Entra Sign-In Dates
item.description: A practical guide to Microsoft Entra ID sign-in timestamps, including interactive, non-interactive and successful sign-ins, and how to choose the correct value when identifying inactive accounts.

item.title: Returning Data from Office Scripts to Power Automate and Power Apps
item.description: Learn how to return strings, numbers and structured results from Office Scripts, use them in Power Automate, and pass the response back to a Power App with practical examples.

item.title: Teams Telephony Self-Service Automation
item.description: A self-service Power Platform solution enabling authorised users to manage Microsoft Teams telephony routing without requiring direct administrative access.

item.title: SharePoint Usage Analytics & Power BI
item.description: A reporting pipeline that captures historical SharePoint usage data and transforms it into management analytics in Power BI.

item.title: Handling Pagination When Calling Microsoft Graph from Power Automate
item.description: A practical guide to handling Microsoft Graph pagination and @odata.nextLink reliably in Power Automate.

item.title: Fixing Teams Adaptive Card Payload Limit Errors in Power Automate
item.description: A practical guide to troubleshooting and resolving Microsoft Teams Adaptive Card payload limit errors in Power Automate, including ways to reduce card size and design more reliable notifications.

item.title: Automated Inactive Account Lifecycle Management
item.description: An automated Microsoft Entra ID lifecycle process for identifying inactive accounts, managing staged warnings and safely progressing accounts towards removal.
